Welcome to the Langstone Cliff Hotel
You’ll find our family-run hotel set within 19 acres of woodlands, right on the beautiful south coast of Devon. Thanks to our stunning location by the sea, the Langstone Cliff is the only choice when it comes to enjoying a beautiful South Devon hotel getaway.
Overlooking the Exe Estuary, we are the only Dawlish hotel that is surrounded by luscious lawns and gardens, not forgetting the magnificent sea views that lead down to the golden sandy beaches and the Warren. Our hotel’s reputation is unrivalled and it is something the Owners (the Roger’s family) are extremely proud of. With the beach just a short walk away via a public footpath and the internationally famous nature reserve at Dawlish Warren nearby, why would you want to stay anywhere else?

Please note that all penalties come directly from Smart Parking, not the hotel, and if you receive a fine and wish to contest it, you will need to contact Smart Parking. There is parking for over 200 cars plus space for coaches.

Some Of The Comfiest Beds Amongst Dawlish Warren Hotels
The hotel has 64 en-suite bedrooms across two floors, there is a lift and four staircases to the first floor. 17 of the rooms have private balconies and many have sea views. Our bright and spacious hotel rooms are regularly updated in order to maintain the highest standards of comfort and convenience. All are tastefully decorated with colour co-ordinated furnishings and fabrics. There are 6 Family Suites comprising of two or (in one case) three bedrooms off a small lobby with a bathroom. There is one large ground floor suite with a spacious lounge area. Many of our rooms now have air conditioning.
All of our rooms include:
En-suite bathroom with bath or shower.
Remote control Freeview LCD colour television with satellite (inc. Sky Sports)
Free Wi-Fi
Direct dial telephone
Tea and Coffee making facilities
Hairdryer
Baby listening is available for all hotel bedrooms
We currently have beds in the following sizes: King size (6’6″ x 5’0), Double (6’3″x 4’6″) and Single (6’3″x 3’0″). We also have a number of cosy mini divan beds for young children (5’0 x 2’6″) and a selection of cots. We pride ourselves on not using any “Z” Beds- all of our beds are pocket sprung with 1200 spring counts by either Hypnos or Mattisons. This means that we have some of the comfiest beds of any Dawlish Warren hotel. After all, everyone deserves a good night sleep.
Babies and Children
Up to two children aged under 10 are free of charge for all food (pre-booked) and accommodation when sharing a family room with two adults.
Additional children and children aged 10 – 16 are charged at 25% of the room tariff.
Please enquire for bookings including more than 2 adults per room.
For more information on child charges please contact us on 01626 248993.
Dog Friendly Hotel in Devon
Dogs are allowed in all bedrooms and charged at £15.00 per dog per night, this does not include food. Owners must be in total control at all time.  Dogs are not permitted in the restaurants.  Please do not allow your animals on the furniture.
If you would like more information on some of our other services or more specifically about the bedrooms, please take a look at our rooms above. Alternatively, to book, please contact us on 01626 247802  or  book online .

Enjour our Hotel in devon with Indoor and Outdoor swimming pools
If you’re planning a proper family break on the coast, Langstone Cliff Hotel is the sort of place that makes things easy from the moment you arrive. It’s one of those family hotels in Devon with a swimming pool where everyone can do their own thing whether that’s the kids splashing about or parents taking a well-earned breather.
Set in a relaxed seaside spot, it’s a welcoming family hotel that guests often come back to, thanks to its laid-back atmosphere and plenty of space to unwind. As one of the more popular hotels in Devon with swimming pools, it offers both indoor and outdoor options, so there’s always something to enjoy, whatever the weather throws at you.
The indoor pool is especially handy on cooler days, making it a great choice if you’re searching for family hotels in Devon with an indoor swimming pool or pool facilities for year-round fun. Everything here is designed with families in mind, which is why so many people see it as a genuinely family-friendly hotel in Devon.
Why Choose Langstone Cliff Hotel?
Looking for a coastal hotel in South Devon where the swimming pool is just as much part of the escape as the seaside? Langstone Cliff offers both indoor and outdoor pools in a relaxed, coastal setting, making it easy to switch between pool time and beach walks at your own pace.
It’s this combination of great leisure facilities and a beautiful seaside location that makes it a standout beach hotel South Devon guests love coming back to.
Here’s why it’s such a popular choice:
Unbeatable coastal location
Set within 19 acres of gardens and woodland, with views over the Exe Estuary and just a short walk to the beach. Ideal if you’re searching for a hotel in Devon by the sea.
Comfortable rooms with a view
A range of en-suite rooms, including options with sea views and private balconies. Perfect for those looking for hotels in South Devon with sea views and balcony
Kids under 10 stay free
Families are especially well looked after here, with selected stays offering great value through our kids stay free deal, making it even easier to enjoy a family break on the coast.
Great on-site facilities
Enjoy indoor and outdoor swimming pools, tennis courts and family-friendly entertainment , all without leaving the hotel grounds.
Best rates when you book direct
For the best prices, exclusive offers, and added flexibility, it always pays to book your stay directly with the hotel.
Relaxed, friendly atmosphere
A family-run feel that keeps guests coming back, offering everything you’d expect from a quality coastal hotel South Devon
